g.text: A sonic throat connects subsonic inlet flow to a supersonic nozzle branch

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Quasi-one-dimensional ideal-gas nozzle with A/At=1+4(x−0.5)². Choked design branch is shock-free; the unchoked branch has A*/At=1/1.2. Area alone admits
two Mach roots; reservoir and back pressure select the realized solution. Relative radius is √(A/At).
